overview: The J&K Handicrafts Development Corporation Scheme is a state-level initiative aimed at promoting and developing the handicrafts sector in Jammu and Kashmir. It focuses on supporting artisans and handicraft units through financial assistance, infrastructure development, and market linkages. The scheme seeks to preserve traditional crafts, enhance productivity, and improve the socio-economic conditions of artisans in the region.
objectives: Promote and develop handicrafts industry in Jammu and Kashmir
Provide financial assistance to artisans and handicraft units
Upgrade infrastructure and technology in handicraft production
Enhance market access and export potential for handicraft products
Preserve traditional crafts and skills of the region
Generate employment and improve livelihoods of artisans
eligibility: Artisans, handicraft units, cooperatives, and MSMEs engaged in handicraft activities in Jammu and Kashmir are eligible to apply under the scheme. Beneficiaries must be registered with the concerned authorities and possess valid identification and business documents.
benefits: Financial assistance for setting up new units, modernization of existing units, raw material procurement, marketing support, participation in exhibitions, infrastructure development, skill training, and design development support. Subsidies are provided on capital expenditure and working capital requirements.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial support in the form of subsidies ranging from 20% to 50% of the project cost, depending on the category of beneficiary and nature of activity. Assistance is disbursed through the J&K Handicrafts Development Corporation after project appraisal and approval. The support covers capital investment, working capital, and infrastructure development.
application_process: 1. Submit application form to the J&K Handicrafts Development Corporation. 2. Attach required documents including project report, registration certificates, and identity proof. 3. Application undergoes scrutiny and field verification. 4. Approved projects are sanctioned financial assistance. 5. Funds are released in installments based on project progress and utilization certificates.
required_documents: Identity and address proof of applicant
Quotations for machinery and equipment and raw materials
Partnership deed or memorandum of association (if applicable)
caveats: Subsidy is subject to availability of funds and approval of the screening committee
Beneficiaries must utilize funds only for the approved project purpose
Failure to submit utilization certificates may lead to recovery of funds
Scheme benefits are not applicable for units availing similar benefits from other government schemes
